beats.headline: Here piggy, piggy
beats.text: Five mana, and it tells you where everything is that is neither a crawler nor red-tagged, out past the edge of the map. Everything it finds hears the ping, though not where it came from, which is why the System files it under names like the Night Dread and says it is for those who do not care if their quarry knows they are coming. In a castle full of robots it turns up almost nothing, which is how a drake stands out: orange on the map, somebody's pet.
